title: Geo-aware Model Fallback Playbook and Prospect Thermal Map
creator: Priya Rao
description: Create an actionable playbook and visual 'thermal map' of prospects and regions that are most sensitive to model availability and latency. The deliverable will guide sales/procurement conversations and engineering runbooks for region-aware fallback policies (model variants, quantized fallbacks, cross-region routing).
background: We have recurring inbound requests from enterprise prospects about guaranteed latency and fallback strategies for regions (APAC, EU). Meanwhile, competitive modeling shows several providers offering regional bundles and reserved capacity. We need a product-facing artifact that synthesizes market sensitivity, procurement triggers, and recommended fallback policies by prospect cohort.
objectives: Map prospect cohorts by latency sensitivity and procurement tolerance
Define a prioritized set of model-fallback bundles and their engineering implications
Produce a thermal map (visual) for GTM to use in pitch decks and SRE runbooks
Surface procurement trigger thresholds for reserved capacity vs hosted API
deliverables: PDF playbook: fallback strategies, trade-offs, cost deltas
Interactive thermal map (Tableau/Looker) keyed by region + buyer persona
One-pager for sales with procurement trigger checklist
Engineering backlog: prioritized runway tasks to enable recommended fallback policies
user_stories: As a sales engineer, I want a visual map that shows which prospects require regional reserved capacity so I can propose the right package
As a platform engineer, I want a prioritized list of fallback configurations (model variants, quantization, cross-region routing) so we can implement low-effort resiliency
As a product manager, I want procurement trigger thresholds by cohort so we can define SLA tiers and pricing options
acceptance_criteria: Thermal map includes at least 6 representative prospect cohorts and 4 regions (NA, EU, APAC, LATAM)
Playbook lists fallbacks with estimated R&D effort (T-shirt sizing) and expected unit-cost delta
Sales one-pager reviewed and approved by Solutions Engineering and Growth
Engineering backlog items created with linked tickets (ENG-xxxx) and clear acceptance criteria
success_metrics: Reduction in sales cycle time for latency-sensitive prospects by 20% in pilot accounts
>75% positive feedback from solution engineers on playbook usefulness
2 engineering fallback patterns implemented as prototypes by the release due date
tasks: Run market interviews with 8 existing enterprise prospects (GTM + AE coordination)
Analyze latency sensitivity signals from usage logs and support tickets (Data + Analytics)
Prototype thermal map in Looker with region, cohort, and procurement signals
Draft playbook and cost-impact tables; circulate to Eng and SRE for technical review
Create engineering tickets for top-2 prioritized fallback mechanisms
Prep sales one-pager and schedule walkthrough with Solutions Eng
risks: Data quality: prospect signals may be noisy and require manual validation
Engineering constraints: some fallback patterns require infra changes not in current roadmap
Market shift: competitors could change pricing quickly, invalidating some procurement thresholds
